India Denies Official Involvement in Track II Talks with Pakistan

India has officially rejected reports suggesting its participation in or backing of 'Track II' dialogues with Pakistan. Foreign Secretary Vikram Misri stated that such talks hold no value and that the Indian government is not involved. This clarification comes amid speculation about unofficial diplomatic engagements between the two nations.
